title: Integrated AI and Wireless for Sustainable Mobile Network Evolutions
summary: The Venus project describes real-time AI prediction of ionospheric delay. A separate improvement in positioning or communication quality is not established.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The Venus project combines wireless infrastructure with AI functions, including real-time prediction of ionospheric delay, which can affect radio-signal propagation and positioning. Resulting improvements in positioning and communication quality remain unquantified. Separate chip, compiler, and open-source infrastructure gains have not been attributed to the prediction system.
purpose: Use AI to predict ionospheric delay in support of communications and positioning. The benefit remains intended.

ratings.reason: Real-time AI ionospheric-delay prediction is proposed for communications research. Resulting positioning and communication improvements remain unquantified. Reported hardware and compiler efficiency gains have not been linked to this application.

ai_role.statement: The proposed AI function would predict ionospheric delay in real time. The account provides no separate evaluation of its effect on positioning or communication outcomes.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 4: Integrated AI and Wireless for Sustainable Mobile Network Evolutions

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: AI ionospheric-delay prediction for wireless positioning
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
